name: wc
description: Word Count: prints, for each file, the number of lines, words and bytes, then a total if there are several files. At the end of a pipe, wc -l is used to count results. Watch out: wc -l counts newline characters, so a last line without a newline is not counted.

options.description: Counts characters (an accented character counts as one, versus two bytes in UTF-8).
Prints the length of the longest line.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to analyze. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: Lines, words and bytes of the file.
Number of lines in each Python script, with the total.
Counts the entries in the current directory.
Counts the TODOs in a project.
